title: How Not to Land an Orbital Rocket Booster
summary: SpaceX's own compilation of failed orbital booster landing attempts, set to sound, showing the crashes before landings succeeded.
why: HN uses it as evidence that SpaceX iterated through visible failures and is open and humorous about them.

quote.text: you might enjoy this official SpaceX Blooper reel from 2017 that shows the numerous spectacular failures that they worked through.
